searchText: I believe IELE was designed for Cardano. This opcodes reference actually isn't up to date (see wolflo's comment here: https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website/issues/3900#issuecomment-919589122). The ethereum.org team are working on adding a canonical opcodes reference to the developer docs. If anyone has the time we could use some help reviewing this PR incase we're missing anything: https://github.com/ethereum/ethereum-org-website/pull/4170 <@!643099918998831144> the reference is up to date, it just doesn't describe in detail the semantics of `JUMP`, `JUMPI` and`JUMPDEST` Ah you're right. My mistake I misremembered. Thanks for checking out the PR 👍 Is the Yellow Paper specification of the opcodes up to date? last i checked it wasn’t updated for london?
